text: I can name the seven steps in order and say what each one hands to the next.
I can state the 45-minute budget (5/5/5/5/10/10/5), where I would be at minutes 5, 20, 30 and 40, and how it changes for 60 minutes.
I end every step with one sentence naming its consequence for the design.
I can signpost, check in at step boundaries, and decide when to ask versus proceed with a stated assumption.
I can run the URL shortener from requirements to wrap-up from memory, including 38.6 writes/s, 3,860 reads/s, 19,500/s peak, 62⁷ and 0.17%.
I have a one-sentence recovery line ready for running over time, spotting my own mistake, and being cut short.
